release_read.basis: Q3 net sales $271.2m (+0.4%, +2.0% cc) against a ~$247m consensus (+9.7%), adjusted EPS $0.23 against $0.03, gross margin 59.8% (+10.8 pts), and the FY2026 sales guide raised to $980-990m, well above the ~$955m street at the bottom of the old $954-974m range; a clean beat-and-raise on every line the thesis named, sized above the 15.9% median past reaction.

release.headline: Fossil Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results; raises full-year 2026 outlook

vs_bar.consensus_source: null: no street number found; company had guided 'upper 50s' per the judges' notes

key_line.detail: Raised to $980-990m ex-FX (prior $954-974m, FY consensus ~$955m); adjusted operating margin 5.5-6.5%; positive FCF. Implied Q4 ~$274-284m, i.e. growth vs the prior year.

guidance.detail: FY26 sales $980-990m vs street ~$955m (+3%); top of the old range was $974m.

call.detail: Call held last night; no transcript read in the time available. Release: YTD ahead of management's expectations, 'just at the beginning' of the growth journey. Nothing in the session itself.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched: out of time before the 09:24 compile. No analyst action or headline is used in this review.

tape_read.note: Robust reference $9.93 (median last 5) = +26.2% vs the $7.87 prior close, up from +21.5% after hours; 100 prints, 20 in the last 30 min, last print 09:15, not stale. Range $9.45-10.09. That is 1.65x the 15.9% historical median and 8 points above the frozen +18% release read, near the top of the past reactions (29.8%, 29.1%). Small caps +0.9% pre-market.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was FY consensus at the bottom of a guide that called for Q4 growth, plus an easy margin comparison; the guide was raised above the old top and the gross margin came in at 59.8%.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market that kept rising from after-hours to 09:15, so the open should hold most of the +26%; a gap this large (well beyond the implied move and 8 points over the release read) on an amc name has had a night to price and tends to give some back by 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn sterk (omzet en winst ruim boven verwachting, jaarprognose verhoogd), maar de voorbeurskoers staat al ongeveer 26% hoger, meer dan de cijfers volgens onze inschatting rechtvaardigen (ongeveer 18%). Na een nacht om de cijfers te lezen geeft zo'n grote sprong vaak een deel terug. Verkoop bij de opening en neem de winst.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt naar rond 18-20% boven het slot van gisteren, is de opening niet meer overdreven en is vasthouden tot 10:00 te overwegen.
